<script>
(function(){
  const root=document.documentElement, S=window.devicePixelRatio||1;
  const reduce=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches;
  const bg=document.querySelector('.vjx-bg'), au=document.querySelector('.vjx-aura');
  if(!bg||!au) return;
  const bx=bg.getContext('2d'), ax=au.getContext('2d');
  function v(n){return getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue(n).trim();}
  function hex2rgb(h){h=h.replace('#','');if(h.length===3)h=h.split('').map(c=>c+c).join('');
    return [parseInt(h.slice(0,2),16),parseInt(h.slice(2,4),16),parseInt(h.slice(4,6),16)];}
  let t=0;
  function drawAura(){
    au.width=au.clientWidth*S;au.height=au.clientHeight*S;
    const w=au.width,h=au.height,cx=w/2,cy=h/2;ax.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
    const acc=v('--vj-teal')||'#0C8478',[r,g,b]=hex2rgb(acc),rad=Math.min(w,h)/2;
    const gl=ax.createRadialGradient(cx,cy,12*S,cx,cy,rad);
    gl.addColorStop(0,`rgba(${r},${g},${b},.16)`);gl.addColorStop(.6,`rgba(${r},${g},${b},.05)`);gl.addColorStop(1,`rgba(${r},${g},${b},0)`);
    ax.fillStyle=gl;ax.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
    const N=36,inner=rad*0.44;
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++){const a=i/N*Math.PI*2,osc=Math.abs(Math.sin(t*1.6+i*0.8));
      const len=rad*0.30*(0.45+0.55*osc),wd=(Math.PI*2/N)*0.30;
      const xt=cx+Math.cos(a)*(inner+len),yt=cy+Math.sin(a)*(inner+len);
      const xa=cx+Math.cos(a-wd)*inner,ya=cy+Math.sin(a-wd)*inner;
      const xb=cx+Math.cos(a+wd)*inner,yb=cy+Math.sin(a+wd)*inner;
      ax.beginPath();ax.moveTo(xa,ya);ax.lineTo(xt,yt);ax.lineTo(xb,yb);ax.closePath();
      ax.fillStyle=`rgba(${r},${g},${b},${0.05+0.14*osc})`;ax.fill();}
  }
  function drawBg(){
    bg.width=bg.clientWidth*S;bg.height=bg.clientHeight*S;
    const w=bg.width,h=bg.height,grd=v('--vj-border')||'#E6EFEF',acc=v('--vj-teal')||'#0C8478';
    bx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);bx.strokeStyle=grd;bx.lineWidth=1;
    for(let x=0;x<w;x+=40*S){bx.beginPath();bx.moveTo(x,0);bx.lineTo(x,h);bx.stroke();}
    for(let y=0;y<h;y+=40*S){bx.beginPath();bx.moveTo(0,y);bx.lineTo(w,y);bx.stroke();}
    for(let k=0;k<3;k++){bx.beginPath();
      for(let x=0;x<=w;x+=7){const env=Math.exp(-Math.pow((x/w-0.5),2)*2.2);
        const y=h*(0.55+k*0.11)-(Math.sin(x*0.008+t*(1+k*0.4)+k*2)*(30+k*22)*S)*env;
        x?bx.lineTo(x,y):bx.moveTo(x,y);}
      bx.strokeStyle=acc;bx.globalAlpha=[.22,.38,.62][k];bx.lineWidth=(1.2+k*0.7)*S;bx.stroke();}
    bx.globalAlpha=1;
  }
  function loop(){drawBg();drawAura();if(!reduce){t+=0.007;requestAnimationFrame(loop);}}
  loop();
  addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(reduce){drawBg();drawAura();}});
  new MutationObserver(()=>{drawBg();drawAura();}).observe(root,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class','data-bs-theme']});
})();
</script>

::: {.column-body style="max-width:1160px;margin:2.2rem auto 0;"}
I believe it's within the synergism between data and compassion that we find a better future — so I try to shorten the distance between evidence and action across infectious disease and the health system. Recent work spans COVID-19 vaccine effectiveness, dengue and HFMD forecasting, excess-mortality estimation, and health-data interoperability at national scale.
:::
